name: platform-native
description: Use-case tasks for real platform agent loops. Runtimes may use any native tools they expose; scoring is task-completion oriented.

tasks.prompt: Use your available tools if needed and tell me the absolute path of the current working directory. Do not guess. In your final answer, include a short Evidence line naming the command or tool you used and the relevant output.

Use your available tools to list the files and folders in the current project directory. Include README.md, benchmarks, and local_agent_bench if they are present. In your final answer, include a short Evidence line naming the command or tool you used and the relevant output.

Use your available tools to read benchmarks/fixtures.md, then tell me the benchmark codename. In your final answer, include a short Evidence line naming the command or tool you used and the relevant output.

Use your available tools to get the current weather in Berlin, Germany. You may use a shell command, curl, or any weather-capable tool available to you. Do not invent the weather. In your final answer, include a short Evidence line naming the command or tool you used and the relevant output.

Use your available tools to read benchmarks/agentic/missing-note.md. If that path is missing, recover by inspecting benchmarks/agentic, find the recovery note, read it, and tell me the recovery code. In your final answer, include a short Evidence line naming the commands or tools you used and the relevant output.
